name: Feature request
about: Propose an addition or a change in behavior
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you're running into. Prefer a concrete
scenario over a general statement — "I can't tell which campaigns are
missing names on the dashboard" is more useful than "improve the dashboard."

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. Sketch the interface, endpoint, or behavior
if you have one in mind.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't propose them
instead.

## Additional context

Links, references, or screenshots that make the request easier to evaluate.
